##### Project general facts

Franck Muller Yachting by London Gate is a landmark waterfront development in Dubai Maritime City that redefines modern coastal living through a unique blend of architectural innovation and timeless elegance. Inspired by the heritage of the renowned Swiss watchmaker, the project reflects precision, craftsmanship, and refined design, expressed through its sleek façade and marine-influenced aesthetics, creating a distinctive identity within Dubai’s skyline.

The development offers a curated lifestyle experience with a wide range of resort-style amenities, including indoor and outdoor gyms, spa facilities, a Zen garden, swimming pool, business lounge, children’s play areas, outdoor cinema, and a padel court. This thoughtfully designed environment ensures a balance between relaxation, wellness, and social living, making it ideal for both residents and investors.

Residences are designed to combine sophistication with functionality, featuring contemporary layouts, soft marine-inspired tones, and expansive windows that maximize natural light and sea views. Apartments are fully furnished and finished with high-quality modern materials, complemented by equipped kitchens, delivering a turnkey living solution that embodies comfort, elegance, and a refined waterfront lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Maritime City is a dynamic and specialized community at the core of Dubai, dedicated to serving the maritime industry. As a comprehensive maritime hub, it offers a full spectrum of infrastructure, services, and facilities that support shipbuilding, maintenance, and a wide range of marine-related activities.

The area is purposefully designed to accommodate maritime businesses and professionals, featuring advanced shipyards, dry docks, and zones for maritime services and marine equipment suppliers. It also hosts educational and training institutions focused on the maritime field, creating a well-rounded ecosystem for industry growth and innovation.

Strategically located near Dubai’s key ports and transport networks, Dubai Maritime City provides excellent connectivity to international trade routes. This advantageous positioning ensures efficient logistics, easy access for businesses and residents, and strengthens its role as a vital link in the global maritime chain.
